case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the chapel. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Ploy was after 9 pm.
Ek was seen at the market hall at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Bua was at the shrine from 8 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Bua's lantern was found near the chapel the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
The baker was found dead at the chapel. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the chapel, and a trail leading toward the north row of houses.
Wan was at the tavern from 8 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.
Tawan, Ploy and Nok live in the east row.
Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
Nok sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Nok owns two goats and a lame mule.
Only Ek, Bua and Wan live in the north row of houses.
Tawan was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.

messages.text:

Wan is cleared: [E9: Wan was at the tavern from 8 pm until 1 am; the priest confirms it.] Death was at [E7: around 11 pm], and [R2: Confirmed alibis are reliable.]

That leaves Ek and Bua. Ek's only alibi is [E2: Ek was seen at the market hall at 8 pm], which is three hours before the death and proves nothing. Bua's lantern was ... (cut: over word limit)
ACCUSE: Bua

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

evidence.text: In this village, red clay is found only along the hill track.
Only Mali, Lek and Nok live in the north row of houses.
Lek was at the market hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Nok was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 11 pm; the innkeeper confirms it.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Ploy, Dao and Chai live in the east row.
The old herbalist had planned to visit the city next week.
The old herbalist was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Mali was at the forge from 11 pm until 4 am; the priest confirms it.
Chai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Ploy was at the shrine from 11 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Dao was after 11 pm.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
Dao had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
The next morning, Lek was seen with muddy boots.
Mali's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Mali says it was lent out days ago.
